Sugar Rush Quirk.name: Sugar Rush Quirk
Sugar Rush Quirk.description:
🍬 You turn sugar you eat into a short surge of physical strength.

🌱 At the start you eat about ten grams of sugar for roughly three minutes of strength to lift heavy debris, force a stuck door or overpower an ordinary adult.
📈 With training: stronger lifts, controlled jumps, protective holds, blows against tougher obstacles.
⚠️ You need to eat sugar and grow duller during the surge; extra sugar cannot remove that cost, and you gain no speed, armor or healing.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Finite Fuel, as each surge consumes sugar and eventually ends.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Rikido Sato's Sugar Rush. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.
🎒 Starts with: Quirk fuel pack x5, Fuel belt

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Stamina +10, Quirk Output +10, Athletics +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Sweet Lift, Fueled Strike
Sugar Rush Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: eaten sugar briefly boosts strength. Start: about 10 g, roughly 3 minutes: heavy debris, jammed doors, blows beyond an ordinary adult. Harder lifts, controlled strength need training.
Limits: must be eaten, not smelled, touched or carried. Strength only: no speed, intellect, durability or healing. Thinking dulls during the boost, hurting complex choices. More sugar: more or longer effort within trained limits, heavier aftermath. Then normal strength, maybe tired. Unsupported loads can collapse on release.
Quirk Strain: light: brief lift or strike; moderate: forceful jump, grapple, held support; heavy: moving major debris, fighting the full surge; severe: signature effort, repeated high-power surges.
Drawback: built in, the canon Finite Fuel.
Canon: Rikido Sato's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Transformation.
Law: user answers for injuries and structural damage.
Look: swelling muscles.
